name: Responsive UI Testing
description: Check the same page at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths in the shared Browser session, using screenshots rather than CSS source.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the page in the shared Browser session.
Apply the desktop, tablet, and mobile presets.
Capture each viewport as the user sees it.
See content below the fold at a narrow width.
Record the viewport that was applied.

validation.rule: Screenshots exist for desktop, tablet, and mobile. Overflow, clipping, broken navigation, stacking, or unreadable controls are reported only from those screenshots.
